reviews.title: Great product, horrible directions
reviews.body: Okay so the slide itself is awesome. Our children love it, keeps them busy. The frustrating part was putting it together. We seem to be the type of people to follow the directions and make sure all parts are there etc before starting, well according to the directions we had a lot of missing parts and extra parts. We believe that the directions are old/not updated. So once we got over the possibility of this not properly going together, we starting just putting it tiger how we thought and it worked out in the end. We had no missing parts, so the directions were wrong. It wasn’t too difficult to try to figure out. But definitely frustrating in the beginning. Now that it’s together and being used, I’m glad we bought it. The decals are a tad bit girly, if that matters to you. We got the blue and gray colored one, still looks girly. It’s pretty sturdy, I believe it’s all made of plastic. Good for toddlers.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 18, 2026
reviews.author: Shannon

reviews.title: So perfect for a 1y/o
reviews.body: This slide is a game changer. We had a pikler set that my daughter loved sliding down but it just wasn’t enough. She absolutely loves this slide. It has texture on the slide so it’s pretty nonslip as far as climbing up goes. As long as its in the recommended height, she has no problem sliding down! We had it a few inches below the recommended height and she wasn’t going down as fast as she would have wanted but a few inches higher is perfect.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 30, 2025
reviews.author: Madison Z.

reviews.title: Ducky slide entertainment galore
reviews.body: My 2 year old grandson simply LOVES this slide!  It really helps during the winter doldrums when locked inside as he is full of energy!  Also, the duck design is so sweet.  His favorite stuffed animal is a duck and has used the slide many times.It was also very easy to assemble.  Definitely worth the money!

reviews.author: MusicMan

reviews.title: will fall apart
reviews.body: This slide was awesome until all of the plastic screws/bolts started falling out and getting lost. I saved some, but its useless without all of them. I've contacted Amazon and they are NOT helpful. They never got back to me. I've just contacted Duke Baby in hopes of getting contacted back. My daughter got very little use of  this before it started falling apart. I can't even sell it without directions.

features: Fun, Safe, and Durable – The Perfect Slide for Your Little One! This slide is a must-have for any toddler’s play area.

Give your child endless fun with a safe and sturdy toddler slide designed for indoor playtime! With a wide base, guardrails, and an extended buffer zone to create a gentle slope, this slide ensures a secure and comfortable experience for little adventurers. Whether in the living room, playroom, this lightweight yet sturdy slide is easy to assemble and move, ensuring hassle-free fun anytime, anywhere!

Versatile Modern Design - This bedside/couch slide features adjustable height and car-shaped handrails, blending seamlessly with any room decor. Ideal for toddler beds, nugget couches, and playrooms, this stylish slide enhances playtime with added fun and versatility

Ideal First Slide for Young Kids - This sofa slide features anti-skid pads for stability on sofas, beds, stairs, and other surfaces. Its gentle slope provides a smooth, gradual slide for young children, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience.

Safe & Durable HDPE Material - This sofa slide is crafted from non-toxic, durable HDPE. It features a long slide board with sturdy side rails and smooth edges, supporting up to 120 lbs and growing with your child.

ASTM Certified for Toddlers - This sofa slide is ASTM certified, promoting coordination, balance, and adventurous play. Ideal as a holiday or birthday gift, it’s a toy that grows with your child and family
Easy Assembly & Cleaning - Assemble the toddler slide in just 20 minutes without extra tools. Serrated nuts ensure stability, and the smooth, dust-proof surface is easy to wipe clean.
